definitions.gloss: camera shake; blurring from hand movement
definitions.explanation: Blurring in a photograph or video caused by the photographer's hand shaking or moving during the shot. A common problem in low-light conditions or when using long focal lengths.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手|て}ぶれ⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The photo is blurry from camera shake.

examples.japanese: {手|て}ぶれ⟦{補正|ほせい}→補正：18527_hosei⟧⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついた⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ほしい。
examples.english: I want a camera with image stabilization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}する→撮影する：21990_satsueisuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{手|て}ぶれしやすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{三脚|さんきゃく}→三脚：06993_sankyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's easy to get camera shake when shooting in dark places, so you should use a tripod.

notes:
A photography term that has become common in everyday language with the widespread use of smartphones and digital cameras. Also written as {手振|てぶ}れ or {手ブレ|てぶれ}.

FORMS:
⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦ぶれ→ぶれ：19846_bure⟧ (shake, blur — from ⟦ぶれる→ぶれる：10522_bureru⟧, to shake/deviate)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手|て}ぶれ⟦{補正|ほせい}→補正：18527_hosei⟧: image stabilization (literally "camera shake correction")
- {手|て}ぶれ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have camera shake
- {手|て}ぶれ⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧: camera shake prevention
- {手|て}ぶれしやすい: prone to camera shake

RELATED WORDS:
- ピンぼけ: out of focus — caused by incorrect focus, not hand movement
- {被写体|ひしゃたい}⟦ぶれ→ぶれ：19846_bure⟧: subject blur — caused by the subject moving, not the camera
- ⟦{三脚|さんきゃく}→三脚：06993_sankyaku⟧: tripod — the classic solution for camera shake
